Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output. We will train and host

Teachers might curate AI-generated content or upload their own, so we need authoring and review UIs. • Administrators: System operators and content curators (school coordinators or company admins). They manage user accounts, content taxonomy, system settings and compliance. They might be responsible for approving AI-generated content, monitoring filter logs, and ensuring curriculum alignment. • Content Experts/Editors: (could be teachers or SMEs) who validate and annotate AI outputs, ensuring pedagogical correctness. Cloud: Major clouds (AWS/GCP/Azure) offer on-demand GPU instances (e.g. AWS p4d with 8×A100 at ~\$32/ hr) and managed ML services. This avoids CapEx but incurs high OpEx. For instance, training a 13B model (~4×A100 × 1000 hours) costs ~\$128K, and a 70B (~32×A100 × 2000 hrs) could be >\$1M. Inference GPUs run \$3–\$15/hr per GPU. We may hybridize: use cloud for burst capacity or initial experiments, and move stable workloads on-prem. Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output.
